display.purpose: The glucose value being entered or read. Nothing else uses this size.

title.purpose: A section title, an invite code, or the wordmark.

body.purpose: Dates, meal lines, helper copy, buttons, and chips.

motion.name: color
motion.purpose: Hover and focus color shifts on buttons, chips, and fields.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: A button drops one pixel while pressed.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The compact action. Muted Teal, 32px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius); font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Add Reading Button
components.description: The full-width action that starts a reading. 56px, wider corners.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-add"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>Ajouter une glycémie</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-add { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 1rem; font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-add:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-add:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-add:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet alternate action on the cream page.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Archive. A red tint, not a glucose band.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive); height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius); font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Input
components.description: A quiet stroke on the paper. The glucose value field is the exception and has no chrome.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Meal Chip
components.description: A meal or range choice. Selected is Muted Teal. Idle is Card Cream.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-chip-selected, .ds-chip-selected:hover { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border-color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Reading Card
components.description: A meal group on the page. Lighter cream, hairline ring, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card-kicker { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-card-value { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-fraunces), ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The four glucose bands as tinted pills. No fifth status color.
components.html: Dans la cibleHautTrès hautBas
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-status-in { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--status-in) 15%, transparent); color: var(--status-in-fg); } .ds-status-high { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--status-high) 18%, transparent); color: var(--status-high-fg); } .ds-status-alert { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--status-alert) 15%, transparent); color: var(--status-alert-fg); } .ds-status-low { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--status-low) 15%, transparent); color: var(--status-low-fg); }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Four tabs. Active is Muted Teal. The bar hides on a single-task flow.
components.html: Aujourd’huiHistoriqueGraphiqueRéglages
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 95%, transparent); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 6px 8px; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-outfit), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-link-active, .ds-nav-link-active:hover { color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: The name beside a teal droplet tile. The tile is the only glow.
components.html: Gluciel
components.css: .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-logo-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 1rem; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); box-shadow: 0 0 18px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary), transparent 55%); } .ds-logo-name { font-family: var(--font-fraunces), ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--foreground); }

narrative.overview:
Gluciel looks like a paper notebook left on the kitchen table between meals. The page is Cream, the words are Warm Brown, and the only ink that asks for a tap is Muted Teal. Fraunces carries the glucose number and the page title. Outfit carries everything you scan. The mood is warm, quiet, and domestic: paper and ink, not a clinic.

Density stays low. One column, about a phone wide, centered on every viewport. The reading is the loudest thing on the page. Controls are quiet and sure, and they feel pressable: a color shift on hover, a one-pixel drop on press. Saturated color is reserved for the four glucose bands.

The system refuses clinic dashboards, neon continuous-glucose apps, and purple wellness gradients. Light is the shipped theme.
keyCharacteristics: A single cream column, never a dashboard grid
Fraunces for the number and the title, Outfit for the rest
Muted Teal for actions, four bands for glucose status
Tonal paper: lighter cards, hairline rings, no drop shadows

rules.name: The Band Rule
rules.body: Saturated color belongs to the four glucose bands, or to Muted Teal when something can be tapped. The page stays Cream and Warm Brown. If a screen is mostly teal or mostly amber, it has broken the carnet.

rules.name: The Light Rule
rules.body: The shipped theme is light. A dark token block exists in the stylesheet and the app forces light. Do not design a screen against the dark block.

rules.name: The Number Rule
rules.body: The glucose value is Fraunces at display size, and it is the loudest thing on the page. A button, a chip, or a badge does not outrank it.

rules.name: The Serif Rarity Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for the value, the page title, the section title, and the wordmark. Outfit sets every repeated label, list row, and control.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: A new screen is a single 32rem column with 16px of side padding. If a layout needs a sidebar, a data table across the viewport, or a multi-column dashboard, it is not this carnet.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not cast shadows. Depth is a lighter card on Cream, plus a hairline ring. The logo mark is the only glow.

rules.name: The Soft Corner Rule
rules.body: A control is 0.9rem. A card is 1rem, or 1.5rem when it holds a chart. A status or a meal choice is a pill. Do not introduce a sharp corner or a new radius step.

dos: Do keep every screen a single 32rem column with 16px of side padding.
Do set the glucose value in Fraunces at 3.75rem, and page titles in Fraunces at 1.875rem.
Do use Muted Teal for what can be tapped, and the four bands only for glucose status.
Do separate cards from the page by a lighter cream and a hairline ring of Warm Brown at 10%.
Do keep archive and invalid fields on Destructive Red, distinct from Alert Coral.
donts: Don't add a drop shadow to a card, a button, or a sheet. The logo tile is the only glow.
Don't use clinic-dashboard chrome, neon continuous-glucose styling, or a purple wellness gradient.
Don't let a control, a chip, or a badge outrank the glucose number.
Don't design against the unused dark tokens. The app forces light.
Don't reach for the unused chart or sidebar tokens in the stylesheet. The graph draws with In-range Green and High Amber.
